title.zh: Clash Verge Rev 常见报错全景排障：Service 安装失败、订阅更新 0 节点与网络死锁恢复
title.en: Clash Verge Rev Comprehensive Troubleshooting Handbook: Service Mode Failure, 0 Nodes Import & Deadlock Recovery

description.zh: 汇总 Clash Verge Rev 实际运行中的高频疑难杂症与技术排错方案。深入解决 Service Mode 服务安装失败、订阅更新提示 Fetch error 或 0 节点、关闭客户端后系统无法上网（网络死锁）以及虚拟网卡驱动冲突恢复。
description.en: The definitive troubleshooting handbook for Clash Verge Rev. Step-by-step technical solutions for Service Mode installation failures, subscription fetch errors, zero-node parsing bugs, and system-wide internet lockouts after client shutdown.
